items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: And I saw several jobs with George Lewis and Richard McLean and a bunch.

ctx.x: But he helped you with your reading you know? Yeah, he was a good musician. So when they would get a job like that, he would always cut me. And then I played some job with Willis San Diego. Doing the, out on Decatur Street during that time. Right after I left Harold, because I worked with Harold a good while on, at the Popeye on Decatur Street. He had an impression. He had an outfit out there. And I saw several jobs with George Lewis and Richard McLean and a bunch.
You stayed with George Lewis a good while ago?
